Name: (AT) Kyuya's Dragon To Ride
Author: CritMe20
Description:
[b]This is an Alternative Textures conversion of Kyuya's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5679]Dragon To Ride[/url] mod.

[/b]In order for this mod to work you need to have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] downloaded and added into your mods file.
There are two variations of dragons; Black and Red which are Kyuya's original design. This mod only changes the textures of your horse!

[b]Installation
[/b]1.Download and extract the files.
2.Put the main folder in "Mods".

[b]How to change textures
[/b]1. Purchase Scissors from Robin.
2. Use the Scissors tool to apply your chosen texture to entities, in this case your horse.

For more information regarding Alternative Textures and its tools visit their mod site linked above!
